Handbook carries 'COPYRIGHT 2005 AAMVA' so it is the legacy AAMVA manual as of the 2022 edition. No counts or pass marks found on any reachable FLHSMV page; flhsmv.gov CDL pages blocked.

test_language.note: County tax collector reposting FLHSMV news: all knowledge and skills exams English-only effective Feb 6, 2026, CDL/CLP included; translation services ended. Volusia tax collector page (https://volusiatax.gov/join-the-line/cdl-exams.html) says same, ASL still allowed. Original flhsmv.gov release not fetched (site blocked).

manual_edition.note: Spanish edition cover July 2022, AAMVA 2005 copyright, lists 8 knowledge tests (GK, passenger, air brakes, combination, hazmat, tank, doubles/triples, school bus), no counts. English edition URL not opened.
